decisions.decision: Board agreed a minimum bid for the Jones House project of $85,000, with the proposal to be ready to go out to bid for February 2011 (announced by Paula, no recorded vote).
decisions.quote: agreed on a minimum bid for the project of $85,000, as the goal is to maintain the significant historical structure.

decisions.decision: Licenses will not be released until paperwork, insurance certificates and tax payment agreements are in place with all applicants; the board may call hold on any establishment.
decisions.quote: noted that licenses would not be released until all paperwork, insurance certificates and tax payment agreements have been reached with all.

decisions.decision: If license applicants in arrears are not paid, the board can withhold the license and schedule appointments with them at the January 4, 2011 meeting if necessary.
decisions.quote: and if necessary can schedule appointments with these individuals for that meeting.

decisions.decision: Town Manager asked board members to tell her whether they plan to attend the MMA Annual Meeting in January 2011.
decisions.quote: kerry asked members of the board to let her know whether they are planning the mma annual meeting

decisions.decision: Chair will follow up with the IT Director on GIS access, as many departments are not using the system.
decisions.quote: and she will follow up with the it director as many departments are not availing themselves

decisions.decision: Fleet expansion item moved to the January meeting.
decisions.quote: fleet expansion - kerry asked that we move this to january

decisions.decision: Town Manager suggested the Capital Planning Committee work on an equipment purchasing policy, including useful life of equipment, and present it to the board.
decisions.quote: suggested that the capital planning committee work on this and present to the board

decisions.decision: Town Manager proposed a public hearing on the Community Choice Aggregation Plan for the second week in January, to be posted on the website and distributed to committees.
decisions.quote: would propose for the second. week in january and will place on website and distribute to committees.

decisions.decision: Town Manager is preparing another grant application for Summer Street design funding.
decisions.quote: kerry is putting together another application for funding assistance for the design.

decisions.decision: Board scheduled the third meeting in January for discussion of closing the Holman Street bridge.
